from.place: The torsion-free quotient paragraph uses finite presentation of modules on affine Noetherian charts

title: Finitely presented modules
statement: Let $A$ be a ring and $M$ an $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. The module $M$ is *finitely presented* if there are natural numbers $m,n$ and an exact sequence $A^m\to A^n\to M\to0$ of $A$-modules.

source.place: Tag 0517 (finite modules and finitely presented modules), Definition 0518

mathlib_searches.query: module finitely presented iff cokernel of map between finite free modules
